scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,ws -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w ws"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w ws
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w ws && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w ws && npm run test -w web
